outline.chapter_title: Chapter 1: Introduction to Advanced Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models
outline.description: This chapter introduces the core challenges of teaching machines mathematical reasoning and establishes the gap between public knowledge and private frontier models. It outlines the objectives of the DeepSeekMath project, presenting it as a solution that bridges the performance gap between open-source 7B models and massive closed-source systems.
subtopics: The Challenge of Structured Mathematical Reasoning
Limitations of Current Open-Source vs. Closed-State Models
Overview of DeepSeekMath Architecture and Goals
Key Contributions: Scalable Pre-training and Efficient RL

outline.chapter_title: Chapter 2: Constructing High-Quality Mathematical Corpora from Web Noise
outline.description: Students learn the methodology behind building the 'DeepSeekMath Corpus,' a critical enabler for success. This chapter breaks down the iterative data mining pipeline using FastText classifiers, distinguishing between successful strategies (Common Crawl mining) versus ineffective ones (reliance on ArXiv).
subtopics: FastText Classification Pipeline for Domain Mining
Multi-Iterative Refinement via Manual Annotation and Clustering
Comparative Analysis: Why Common Crawl Outperformed ArXiv
